rule: Every material v2 decision is logged with why, evidence, losers, and reverse conditions.

entries.title: Open V2 Master Build Plan; freeze Explorer Experience 0.1 as HOLD
entries.decision: Define what v2.0 means at 100% before any Arkansas research campaign, fiscal modeling, agency redesign, tax rates, or pilots.
entries.why: v1 taught that completion requires a finish line. v2 must not confuse project growth with blueprint completion.
alternatives_rejected: Continuing Explorer expansion before V2 map freeze
entries.could_reverse_if: Plan fails orphan test or scope is shown incomplete after deliberate audit.
entries.v1_doctrine_impact: NONE — applications lane only; no silent doctrine change.

entries.title: Progress measured by resolved objects, not words written
entries.decision: V2 BLUEPRINT percent derives from object counters (baseline, functions, fiscal flows, legal pathways, households, geographies, propositions, implementation objects).
entries.why: Word-count and research volume inflated dials in earlier eras.
entries.could_reverse_if: Object taxonomy proven unfit after first gate — amend explicitly.

entries.title: UNKNOWN is a completed research result when needed evidence does not exist
entries.decision: When the evidence required for the current decision does not exist, record UNKNOWN as a completed result for that decision slot — do not endlessly research.
entries.why: Protects against three-week rabbit holes when three facts would suffice.
alternatives_rejected: Research until every box has a number
entries.could_reverse_if: Never — this is a permanent epistemic rule for v2.

entries.title: v2 may challenge applications of v1; may not silently change v1 doctrine
entries.decision: If implementation reveals a foundational proposition is defective, stop, label a potential v2.0 architectural amendment, run hostile test, and record version change.
entries.could_reverse_if: Never as a silent path — only explicit amendment process.

entries.title: Orphan / scope / completion audit PASS
entries.decision: Pass orphan test after assigning adversarial nominations (2 NEW domains: human_services, insurance_and_risk; remaining MERGE/HOME). Material orphans open = 0.
entries.why: Cannot open V2.1 until nothing important about operating Arkansas sits outside the map.
entries.could_reverse_if: A material operating surface is later shown with no HOME/MERGE path — reopen map amendment, do not silently research under wrong home.

entries.title: Freeze v2 build map
entries.decision: Freeze operating-system inventory at 38 domain homes. V2.1 OPEN_NOT_STARTED. Blueprint remains 0% until objects resolve.
entries.why: Define the entire job before attacking it in finite passes.
entries.could_reverse_if: Explicit map amendment after hostile gap — never silent domain drift.

entries.title: Open V2.1 SEE ARKANSAS with five finite passes and 152 closure objects
entries.decision: V2.1 progress = closed B/F/D/E objects / 152. Five passes: people → money → production → power → X-Ray.
entries.why: Honest progress bar; finite work; no permanent research institution.
entries.could_reverse_if: Object taxonomy proven unfit — amend explicitly.

entries.title: Lock geographic lens and household archetypes in V2.1.1
entries.why: Later fiscal proposals must not hide geographic winners/losers behind statewide averages.
entries.could_reverse_if: Region labels proven misleading — amend lens, keep anti-hiding rule.

entries.title: Non-blocking unknowns cannot hold V2.1 open
entries.decision: Unknown Register with BLOCKING/NON-BLOCKING. UNKNOWN-COMPLETE closes an object when needed evidence does not exist.
alternatives_rejected: Research until every box has a number

entries.title: V2-GEO-001 — 75-County Geographic Dimension (narrow amendment)
entries.decision: Add a permanent geographic dimension inside V2.1 SEE ARKANSAS: 75 standardized county digital-twin records (same 12 dimensions), regional relationship graph, county balance sheets, geographic decomposition rule, opportunity portfolio architecture, county UNKNOWN register, and interactive map/data contract.
entries.why: If geography waits until v3, every v2 baseline and redesign must be retrofitted. Arkansas is not one average place. Build the spine now; analyze in v2; personalize in v3.
evidence: User-accepted geographic spine for v2 analysis / v3 personalization
alternatives_rejected: Wait until v3 to collect county architecture
entries.could_reverse_if: Schema proven unfit after first field-first pass — amend schema explicitly, keep anti-ranking and anti-book rules.

entries.title: Close V2.1.2 Government & Money on GR spine + honest UNKNOWN panel
entries.decision: Ship seven joined money ledgers, FY2016–FY2026 historical frame with only FY2025–FY2026 populated, qualitative Fiscal Flexibility Map, Federal Dependency lens, Observed Pattern Register, and field-first GEO government_public_money PROXY across counties. Recommendations remain 0.
entries.why: Need a reconciled public-money machine for V2.2 without inventing federal/historical precision.
alternatives_rejected: Delay V2.1.2 until perfect all-funds anthropology
entries.could_reverse_if: Primary DFA/Fiscal Summary binds shown wrong — correct FACTS and re-open affected objects.

entries.title: Close V2.1.3 with production/ownership separation and honest UNKNOWN ownership
entries.decision: What does Arkansas actually produce, who owns the productive capacity, where does the capital come from, where does economic value go, and what dependencies make that production possible? Answered at system level with bound FACT spine; ownership of productive capital mostly UNKNOWN-COMPLETE.
entries.why: Need productive machine map before power map and redesign — without inventing ownership shares.
entries.could_reverse_if: Primary GDP/QCEW binds shown wrong — correct and reopen affected objects.

decisions.title: Close V2.1.4 with Arkansas control diagram (power ≠ org chart)
decisions.decision: Who can make, administer, finance, constrain, challenge, or reverse decisions affecting Arkansas' political-economic system? Answered at system resolution with Authority/Change/Constraint ledgers; board roster and FOIA rates UNKNOWN-COMPLETE; emergency_government left OPEN for deeper fill.
decisions.why: Need control diagram before Whole-State X-Ray and redesign — without civics textbook or rankings.
alternatives_rejected: Invent board counts or FOIA rates
decisions.could_reverse_if: Primary constitutional/statutory authority binds shown wrong — correct and reopen affected objects.

decisions.title: Certify V2.1 SEE ARKANSAS — 152/152 dispositioned; 0 structural orphans
decisions.decision: Arkansas can be explained as one joined political-economic system sufficiently for V2.2 redesign to begin. SEE CERTIFIED. UNK-FISC-001 and UNK-FISC-004 preserved as V2.2 blockers. Recommendations during V2.1: 0.
decisions.why: Closure requires disposition and joins, not perfect data density.
decisions.could_reverse_if: Hostile orphan retest finds a true structural hole — reopen affected home only.

decisions.title: Open V2.2 and close V2.2.1 function dispositions for 38 homes
decisions.decision: Lock disposition vocabulary; create 114 F/I/O redesign objects; complete all 38 Function dispositions with four-role tags and V2.1 backlinks. Institution/geography deferred to V2.2.2. No funding design. HOLD used where evidence blockers prevent responsible depth.
decisions.why: Function first prevents agency-boundary redesign and instinctive 'should'.
alternatives_rejected: Clear all eight blockers before starting
decisions.could_reverse_if: Hostile redesign orphan test finds function mis-specified — reopen F object only.
decisions.v1_doctrine_impact: NONE — applies v1 roles/gates to Arkansas SEE

decisions.title: Close V2.2.2 institutional & geographic homes for 38 functions
decisions.decision: Assign institutional architectures to all 38 I objects using five placement tests; separate standards from delivery; apply regionalize/devolve/consolidate/market burdens; publish Functional Geography Atlas and Institutional Future Map; lock no-unfunded-subsidiarity; keep county opportunity portfolios OFF; invent no funding.
decisions.why: Function without institutional geography cannot become an operating model.
decisions.could_reverse_if: Hostile test shows architecture contradicts rights/capacity evidence — reopen I object only.
decisions.v1_doctrine_impact: NONE — applies subsidiarity, Role Conflict, essential≠owned to Arkansas institutions
